headline: Godcrofts and Lykos Isle Flare; Dead Lands Bleeds
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the front line shows sharper localized fighting while the massive attrition corridors remain static. Godcrofts has surged, recording two captures in the past two hours and four in six, raising its 24‑hour flip total to thirteen with the latest action at 07:25 UTC. Lykos Isle remains hot, adding two captures in the last two hours and a fresh turnover at 09:10 UTC around Fort Guile and The Squall. Dead Lands, still the bloodiest sector, added roughly 1,450 colonial and 1,800 warden casualties in the last two hours but its ownership changes have slipped to fourteen for the day, down from sixteen. Farranac Coast logged three captures in the past six hours, the most recent at 05:43 UTC, while Fishermans Row and Stema Landing have gone quiet after earlier bursts, their latest events dated 22:25 and 23:52 UTC yesterday respectively. Tempest Island’s brief flurry at Blackwatch ended at 01:27 UTC with no new moves. The high‑casualty belts — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — continue to post rising losses but show zero territorial movement. Overall strategic‑base ownership is largely unchanged, with Colonials holding the western and southern belts and Wardens the northern and eastern arcs.
